bahrain.title: Bahrain air defences intercept renewed Iranian drone attacks
bahrain.summary: The Bahrain Defence Force said its air defences intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on Sunday, following two drones downed on Friday. Bahrain strongly condemned the renewed strikes.

bahrain.title: MPs review proposed 10% corporate income tax
bahrain.summary: Parliament's financial and economic affairs committee discussed the draft law for a 10% corporate income tax on businesses above set revenue or profit thresholds, with the National Bureau for Revenue chief attending. MPs stressed protecting local firms' competitiveness.

bahrain.title: Social insurance extended to self-employed, freelancers and Bahrainis abroad
bahrain.summary: New rules in the Official Gazette bring self-employed people, freelancers and Bahrainis working abroad into social insurance, and set BD 350 as the minimum monthly salary base for old-age, disability and non-work death cover.

bahrain.title: Shura Council rejects longer pension payments to children
bahrain.summary: The Shura Council voted down amendments that would have paid pensions to eligible children of deceased or retired beneficiaries up to age 24, or 28 for students, citing concern over pension fund finances. The bills go back to Parliament for a second vote.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Bourse to add closing auction session from 1 December
bahrain.summary: From 1 December the bourse will run a closing auction at the end of each trading day to set the closing price by supply and demand, followed by a trading-at-last session where eligible trades can be made at that price.

bahrain.title: Muharraq council panel backs reserving fish selling for Bahrainis
bahrain.summary: A Muharraq Municipal Council committee unanimously supported an urgent proposal to restrict selling fish in local markets to Bahrainis, aiming to protect citizens' livelihoods and stop foreign workers dominating the trade.

bahrain.title: Bahrain elected to chair WTO technical barriers to trade committee
bahrain.summary: Bahrain will chair the World Trade Organisation's Committee on Technical Barriers to Trade for the 2026 to 2027 term, represented by Maryam Al Doseri of its permanent mission in Geneva.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Diabetes Society opens new centre in Aali
bahrain.summary: The society inaugurated its Silver Jubilee Diabetes Centre in Aali, led by Supreme Council for Health chairman Lt Gen Dr Shaikh Mohammed bin Abdulla Al Khalifa, expanding care facilities for patients.

crypto.title: Bitcoin hits four-month low near $62,000 as ETF outflows mount
crypto.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $62,081 on Sunday, its weakest since July, before bouncing above $65,000. Ether and Solana lost around 20% in a week, the fear index hit 10, and US spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35 billion over two weeks.

crypto.title: US moves to seize $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack
crypto.summary: The DOJ won court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of the $6.3 billion taken from Binance on 29 October, which the FBI blames on North Korea. It also disrupted FaceStealer, a deepfake video call scam that stole over $400 million.

crypto.title: Luxor mining platform hit by AI-enabled attack that redirected hashrate
crypto.summary: Attackers breached Luxor's Commander tool and redirected some customers' mining power to another pool. Luxor patched it within two hours, will compensate clients in full, and its CEO warned AI-driven attacks on crypto firms are accelerating.

crypto.title: Korean exchange Coinone warns customers after support data breach
crypto.summary: An attacker breached Coinone's outsourced support provider, possibly exposing names, ID numbers, bank details and passwords shared with support. Coinone says trading and wallets were not hit and urged users to change passwords and watch for phishing.

crypto.title: Coinbase trust charter approved as US senators question crypto charters
crypto.summary: Coinbase's national trust company got final approval to open, giving its custody business a federal framework. Senators Warren and Blumenthal are demanding records on crypto charter approvals and links to Trump-tied ventures.

crypto.title: Thailand proposes daily cap on some stablecoin transfers
crypto.summary: According to the headline, Thailand is seeking a $148,000 daily limit on certain stablecoin transfers to curb money laundering.
